What does Shariah say about wearing tawiz 3738 views Q. Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2470 views Q. Answer ID: 6837 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1729/269=H/1429) It is just superstition of magic (Jadu). You seem to suffer from stomachic and liver diseases, this affects the mind and heart and disturbs the Imagination Faculty. You should consult any expert physician and offer two rakah nafl ( صلاۃ الحاجۃ ) regularly and pray to Allah. You should keep your heart and eyes clean, study the book Bahishti Zewar, keep reciting half or one part of the Holy Quran as per your engagement. Why are Isha and Maghrib salah missed? You should perform Maghrib salah just after the sunset and one or half an hour later perform Isha salah. We do not have addresses of Ulama or Muslims living in Oslo and Norway . Hadthrat Maulana Mufti Muhammad Taqi Usmani Sahib, Darul Uloom Krachi Pakistan , has contacts in those countries, he keeps on visiting them, you should contact him and get your problems solved, in-sha-Allah, he will guide you well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
